A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''waiter''' worked in the [[Upper City Cantina]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', in which the waiter appears, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> the [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]] brought drinks to [[Gana Lavin]] and a young [[Noble/Legends|noble]], apologizing for the time it took.<ref name="KotOR" />
